summary: Joseph revealed who he was and forgave his brothers, telling them God had sent him ahead to save lives. He invited the whole family to come live in Egypt.

story_reel.narration: Joseph couldn't hold back any longer. He sent all his servants out of the room. Then he burst into tears, crying so loudly that people in Pharaoh's palace heard him. He said to his brothers, 'I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?' His brothers couldn't answer. They were terrified! The brother they had sold was now the second most powerful man in Egypt. But Joseph said, 'Come close to me. I am Joseph, your brother, the one you sold into Egypt. But don't be upset or angry with yourselves. God sent me here ahead of you to save lives!' Joseph threw his arms around Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept too. Then he kissed all his brothers and cried with them. After that, they finally talked together. Joseph sent his brothers home with wagons, food, and gifts. 'Go get our father and bring everyone here. I'll take care of you.' When Jacob heard that Joseph was alive, he could hardly believe it. But when he saw the wagons, his spirit came alive again. 'My son Joseph is still alive! I will go and see him.'

memory_verse.text: God sent me before you to preserve life.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can forgive others because Yahweh can turn even hurtful things into good.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Joseph forgave the brothers who hurt him. Is there someone you need to forgive? You can ask God to help you.

quiz.question: What did Joseph say when he revealed himself?
options: 'I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?'

quiz.question: Why did Joseph say God sent him to Egypt?
quiz.explanation: Joseph said, 'God sent me before you to preserve life.'

quiz.question: What happened when Jacob saw the wagons Joseph sent?
quiz.explanation: When Jacob saw the wagons, his spirit revived.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, forgiving can be really hard. Please help me forgive people who have hurt me, like Joseph did. Thank You that You can turn hurtful things into good. Amen.

companion.message: That was the happiest day of my life! Forgiving my brothers set my heart free. Forgiving doesn't mean what happened was okay. It means you let God handle it.
